title: Veera Ranachandi
desc: An underworld criminal, mistaken for a village chief's long-lost daughter, undergoes a profound transformation. This new-found identity empowers her to address the challenges faced by her community.

title: The Great Pre-Wedding Show
desc: A young couple navigates the chaotic world of pre-wedding photography, facing unexpected obstacles and family drama as they try to capture their perfect moments before getting married.

title: Vikrant Rona
desc: When Vikrant Rona sets off to investigate a gruesome murder, a series of tragic deaths leads him to discover a supernatural connection. Subsequently, with varying clues, Vikrant must find the killer.

title: Rocky
desc: Rocky, a student from a broken home, befriends Usha, but her admiration for Vishwas, a guitarist, brings unexpected emotional challenges.

title: Jodi
desc: After receiving a random call from Shalini, Vinod falls in love with her. When his best friend also falls for her, he tries to sabotage Vinod's chances and woo her on his own.
